docs.summary: Result of a navmesh query such as [`SamplePosition`](#api~Prowl.Runtime.NavMeshWorld~SamplePosition), [`Raycast`](#api~Prowl.Runtime.NavMeshWorld~Raycast) or [`FindClosestEdge`](#api~Prowl.Runtime.NavMeshWorld~FindClosestEdge).
The resulting location on the navmesh.
Normal at the hit (edge/wall normal for raycast and closest-edge queries; straight up for position samples).
Distance from the query origin to [`Position`](#api~Prowl.Scaffold.Position).
The area of the polygon at the hit, as a single-area mask. [`Nothing`](#api~Prowl.Runtime.NavMeshAreaMask~Nothing) when there was no polygon to read it from.
True when the query found something.
